description: Validate successful LTE and 5G NSA attach and detach procedure for a single UE under excellent radio conditions.
preconditions: Single isolated cell activated with no inter-cell interference
Single UE under excellent radio conditions as per Clause 4.6
Test configuration parameters recorded
End-to-end LTE or 5G NSA setup operational
testSteps: Configure the test setup according to the test configuration and record parameters in the test report.
Power ON the UE and initiate LTE or 5G NSA attach procedure.
Wait for successful attach indication and verify UE is attached to the correct cell (validate PCI, Global eNB/gNB ID, ARFCN/NR-ARFCN).
Power OFF the UE to initiate detach procedure.
Wait for successful detach confirmation including UE context release and RRC connection release.
Repeat attach and detach steps for a total of 10 iterations.
Capture logs for call flow and signalling messages during each iteration.
expectedResults: Attach success rate is 100% over 10 iterations.
Detach success rate is 100% over 10 iterations.
UE is attached to correct LTE or 5G NSA cell as per configuration.
Signalling messages confirm successful attach and detach as per 3GPP TS 23.401 and TS 37.340.
Attach latency is measured and recorded (Min, Avg, Max) in Table 5-3.
Logs are complete and saved for reference.
postconditions: UE is detached from the network after test completion.
Test logs and KPI data are stored for analysis.
verificationMethods: Verify attach and detach success from UE logs and network messages.
Check KPI tables for 100% success and latency values.
Validate correct cell attachment parameters in UE logs.

description: Validate UE attach failure when radio conditions degrade below excellent thresholds.
preconditions: Single isolated cell activated
UE placed under poor radio conditions below minimum coupling loss threshold
testSteps: Configure the test setup with degraded radio conditions using attenuator or fading generator.
Power ON the UE and attempt LTE or 5G NSA attach procedure.
Monitor attach procedure and signalling logs.
Check for attach failure indications or timeouts.
Power OFF UE to ensure clean detach state.
expectedResults: Attach procedure fails or times out due to poor radio conditions.
Attach success rate is less than 100% or zero.
UE does not attach to the cell or retries attach with failures.
Appropriate failure messages or error codes observed in logs.
postconditions: UE remains detached from the network.
verificationMethods: Check attach failure messages in logs.
Verify attach success rate recorded is below 100%.
Confirm UE does not attach to the cell.

description: Validate attach and detach behavior when UE radio conditions are at the minimum coupling loss limit.
preconditions: Single isolated cell activated
UE placed exactly at minimum coupling loss threshold as defined in Clause 4.6
testSteps: Configure UE radio conditions at the exact minimum coupling loss.
Power ON UE and perform attach procedure.
Verify attach success and latency.
Power OFF UE and perform detach procedure.
Repeat 10 iterations capturing KPIs.
expectedResults: Attach and detach procedures succeed at minimum coupling loss threshold.
Attach and detach success rate approaches 100%.
Attach latency measured and reported.
No unexpected errors or failures due to boundary radio conditions.
commandsUsed: Generic: Capture logs and measure latency
verificationMethods: Verify attach/detach success rates in KPI tables.
Analyze latency for any degradation at boundary conditions.

description: Assess system performance and stability over 10 consecutive attach-detach iterations under excellent radio conditions.
preconditions: Single isolated cell activated
UE placed under excellent radio conditions
Test configuration parameters recorded
testSteps: Power ON UE and perform attach procedure.
Wait for attach completion and measure latency.
Power OFF UE and perform detach procedure.
Repeat steps for 10 consecutive iterations without resetting test environment.
Collect attach success rate, detach success rate, and latency metrics.
expectedResults: Attach and detach success rates remain at 100% over all iterations.
Attach latency remains within acceptable thresholds with minimal variation.
No memory leaks, crashes or performance degradation observed in system logs.
commandsUsed: Generic: Capture logs and measure latency
verificationMethods: Analyze KPI tables for success rates and latency consistency.
Review system stability and resource usage during test.

description: Validate authentication and authorization during LTE and 5G NSA attach procedure.
preconditions: Single isolated cell activated
UE configured with valid and invalid credentials for authentication
testSteps: Power ON UE with valid credentials and perform attach procedure.
Verify successful authentication and authorization in network logs.
Power OFF UE and detach.
Power ON UE with invalid credentials and perform attach procedure.
Verify attach failure due to authentication or authorization rejection.
Capture logs for authentication messages.
expectedResults: UE with valid credentials successfully attaches and authenticates.
UE with invalid credentials fails attach with authentication error.
Network correctly enforces access control and rejects unauthorized UEs.
postconditions: UE detached or remains unattached depending on credential validity.
commandsUsed: Generic: Power ON UE with credential configuration
verificationMethods: Check authentication success/failure messages in logs.
Verify authorization status in network elements.

description: Validate end-to-end integration of 5G NSA attach with Secondary Node Addition and detach with Secondary Node Release procedures.
preconditions: Single isolated cell with LTE MN and 5G SN activated
UE under excellent radio conditions
End-to-end 5G NSA setup operational
testSteps: Power ON UE to attach to LTE MN and initiate Secondary Node Addition to 5G SN as per 3GPP TS 37.340 Clause 10.2.1.
Validate successful attach and Secondary Node Addition via UE logs and signalling messages (SgNB Addition Request and Reconfiguration Complete).
Power OFF UE to initiate detach procedure including Secondary Node Release as per Clause 10.4.1.
Validate Secondary Node Release signalling messages (SgNB Release Request and Acknowledge), UE context release and RRC connection release.
Repeat attach-detach cycle for 10 iterations capturing all relevant KPIs.
expectedResults: Attach success rate and Secondary Node Addition success rate are 100%.
Detach success rate including Secondary Node Release is 100%.
All signalling flows conform to 3GPP specifications.
UE releases SCG configuration correctly on detach.
Logs of SgNB Release Request, Acknowledge, and UE Context Release are present and correct.
postconditions: UE detached and Secondary Node resources released after test.
commandsUsed: Generic: Capture signalling logs for EN-DC procedures
verificationMethods: Verify presence and correctness of Secondary Node Addition and Release messages.
Confirm UE SCG release via RRCConnectionReconfiguration messages.
Check KPIs for success rates.

description: Verify ease of capturing and reporting logs, KPIs, and configuration parameters during the attach-detach test procedure.
preconditions: Test setup configured and operational
Access to logging and KPI capture tools
testSteps: Start logging before UE power ON.
Perform attach and detach procedures as per test case TC_LTE_5GNSA_001.
Stop logging after UE power OFF.
Record all configuration parameters used in the test.
Capture KPIs including attach success rate, detach success rate, and latency.
Generate test report including all captured data.
Evaluate clarity and completeness of logs and reports.
expectedResults: Logs are captured without data loss or corruption.
KPIs are accurately calculated and presented.
Configuration parameters are fully documented.
Test report is clear, complete and easy to interpret.
Test procedure is straightforward to execute by test engineers.
postconditions: Test report and logs stored for future reference.
verificationMethods: Review logs and KPI files for completeness.
Evaluate test report quality and usability feedback from test engineers.

description: Validate attach-detach procedure compatibility across different LTE and 5G NSA software and hardware versions.
preconditions: Test lab with multiple LTE eNodeB and 5G gNodeB versions available
UE capable of LTE and 5G NSA
Test configuration parameters recorded for each version combination
testSteps: For each LTE eNodeB and 5G gNodeB version combination:
Configure test setup and record configuration parameters.
Power ON UE and perform attach procedure to LTE or 5G NSA cell.
Verify successful attach including Secondary Node Addition for 5G NSA.
Power OFF UE and perform detach procedure including Secondary Node Release.
Capture logs and KPIs for each version combination.
Repeat for 10 iterations per combination.
expectedResults: Attach and detach procedures succeed across all tested LTE and 5G NSA versions.
No version incompatibility errors observed in signalling or UE logs.
KPIs (success rates, latency) fall within acceptable ranges for all versions.
postconditions: All UEs detached and network resources released after tests.
verificationMethods: Analyze logs for version-related errors.
Compare KPIs across different version combinations.

description: Simulate UE detach failure due to network signalling issues and validate recovery and error handling.
preconditions: Single isolated cell activated
UE under excellent radio conditions
testSteps: Power ON UE and perform successful attach.
Simulate network signalling failure or delay during detach procedure (e.g., drop detach accept message).
Power OFF UE to initiate detach.
Observe UE and network behavior on missing detach accept.
Check if UE retries detach or recovers gracefully after timeout.
Capture logs of signalling failure and recovery attempts.
expectedResults: UE handles detach failure gracefully and retries or times out as per specification.
Network logs show missing or delayed detach accept messages.
System recovers without crashes or resource leaks.
Detachment is eventually successful or UE enters known error state.
postconditions: UE detached or flagged for manual intervention.
commandsUsed: Generic: Power ON and OFF UE
verificationMethods: Check UE retry or timeout behavior in logs.
Verify system stability during failure.
Confirm detach success or known failure state.

description: Measure attach latency variations under borderline excellent radio conditions and validate latency KPI measurements.
preconditions: Single isolated cell activated
UE placed close to the lower limit of excellent radio conditions
testSteps: Configure radio conditions near lower threshold of excellent range.
Power ON UE and perform attach procedure.
Measure attach latency for each of 10 iterations.
Sort latency values ascending and record Min, Avg, Max latency as per Table 5-3.
Analyze latency variation and outliers.
expectedResults: Attach latency remains within expected range but may show increased variation near threshold.
Latency KPI measurements are correctly captured and reported.
No failed attach attempts due to latency issues.
verificationMethods: Verify latency KPI values in test report.
Analyze latency distribution for anomalies.
